Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.
‍

elements.title: Tanzania. Masterworks of African Sculpture (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the catalogue for Tanzania. Masterworks of African Sculpture highlighted traditional artworks such as a Sukuma mask (pictured)?

elements.title: Ankarette Twynho (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Ankarette Twynho's hanging for poisoning a duchess was a cause célèbre, and has been described by one modern historian as "judicial murder"?

elements.title: China has sanctioned (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that China has sanctioned more than 100 foreign individuals and entities with asset freezes and other restrictions?

elements.title: South Arcade (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that technical issues in the minute before their November 2024 BBC Radio 1 performance meant that South Arcade had to set up while the presenter was announcing them?

elements.title: Kasey Morlock (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Kasey Morlock was one of five NCAA Division II women's basketball players selected for the 25th-anniversary team?

elements.title: Doctor Who series 13 (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Doctor Who series 13 told only a single story, the first time for the show since 1986?

elements.title: Lamtiur Andaliah Panggabean (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the scientific name of a species of crustacean is in honor of ambassador Lamtiur Andaliah Panggabean and her two children?

elements.title: Festival Internacional da Canção (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Milton Nascimento did not enter himself into the second edition of the Festival Internacional da Canção, yet placed second?

elements.title: one-dollar pizza slices (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that one-dollar pizza slices, a unique part of the culture of New York City, were originally sold near homeless shelters?
